info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Investment Portfolio Adjustment API
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Adjustment API allows users to modify and optimize their existing investment portfolios based on updated strategies and market conditions. This operation caters to financial advisors and individual investors who seek to enhance their asset allocations or respond to changes in their investment objectives. By leveraging this API, consumers can efficiently adjust portfolio parameters, ensuring alignment with personal or client goals. Use cases include rebalancing portfolios, adjusting risk levels, and responding to market volatility.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific investment portfolio planning resource identified by RES-100045. You can modify various attributes to reflect the most current investment strategies and objectives.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the investment portfolio planning details for the specified resource. It contains the necessary information to modify existing attributes or add new information relevant to the investment portfolio.
